lastFailure.title: Last failure
lastFailure.at: The last issuance failed {{date}}. cert-manager tries again with a growing delay.
lastFailure.withAttempts_one: The last issuance failed {{date}} ({{count}} failed attempt). cert-manager tries again with a growing delay.
lastFailure.withAttempts_other: The last issuance failed {{date}} ({{count}} failed attempts). cert-manager tries again with a growing delay.
explain.certificate.failed: Issuing failed: the certificate request did not complete. See the last failure below and the chain for the step that failed.
explain.certificate.issuing: A new certificate (revision {{revision}}) is being issued.
explain.certificate.DoesNotExist: The Secret {{secret}} does not exist yet: cert-manager has not issued this certificate.
explain.certificate.MissingData: The Secret {{secret}} lacks a certificate or a private key; cert-manager will issue a new one.
explain.certificate.InvalidKeyPair: The private key in the Secret {{secret}} does not match its certificate.
explain.certificate.InvalidCertificate: The certificate in the Secret {{secret}} cannot be read.
explain.certificate.Expired: The certificate in the Secret {{secret}} has expired.
explain.certificate.IncorrectIssuer: The certificate in the Secret {{secret}} was issued by another issuer than this Certificate names.
explain.certificate.SecretMismatch: The certificate in the Secret {{secret}} does not match what this Certificate asks for (names, key or usages).
explain.certificate.ManuallyTriggered: A renewal was requested by hand.
explain.certificate.Renewing: The certificate is due for renewal.
explain.certificate.notReady: The certificate is not ready; the Ready condition below says why.
explain.request.Denied: An approver denied this request: no issuer will sign it.
explain.request.InvalidRequest: The request is invalid: the issuer will not sign it.
explain.request.notApproved: Waiting for approval: an approver (cert-manager's own, or a policy approver) has not approved the request yet.
explain.request.Pending: Waiting for the issuer to sign the request.
explain.request.Failed: The issuer failed to sign the request.
explain.issuer.ErrRegisterACMEAccount: The ACME account could not be registered: check the server URL, the email and that the cluster can reach the ACME server.
explain.issuer.ErrInitIssuer: The issuer could not be set up; the Ready condition below says why.
explain.issuer.ErrGetKeyPair: The CA Secret of this issuer cannot be read: it is missing or has no tls.crt and tls.key.
explain.issuer.ErrInvalidKeyPair: The CA Secret of this issuer holds a key that does not match its certificate.
explain.issuer.notReady: The issuer is not ready: certificates that use it are not issued.
explain.order.pending: Waiting for its challenges to be solved.
explain.order.ready: All challenges are solved; the certificate is about to be requested from the ACME server.
explain.order.processing: The ACME server is issuing the certificate.
explain.order.invalid: The ACME server rejected the order: one of its challenges failed. Open the failed challenge below.
explain.order.errored: The order failed with an error; see the reason.
explain.order.expired: The order expired before it completed; cert-manager will create a new one.
explain.challenge.httpStatus: The HTTP-01 check of {{domain}} got HTTP {{code}} instead of 200: the request to /.well-known/acme-challenge/ does not reach the solver (check the ingress or route that should send it there).
explain.challenge.noHost: {{domain}} does not resolve in DNS: the ACME server cannot reach it.
explain.challenge.unreachable: {{domain}} cannot be reached (connection refused or timed out): check the load balancer and firewall in front of the solver.
explain.challenge.dnsPropagation: Waiting for the DNS-01 TXT record of {{domain}} to appear in DNS.
explain.challenge.invalid: The ACME server could not validate {{domain}}; see the reason.
explain.challenge.errored: The challenge for {{domain}} failed with an error; see the reason.
explain.challenge.expired: The challenge for {{domain}} expired before it was validated.
explain.challenge.presented: The solver for {{domain}} is in place; waiting for the ACME server to check it.
